title: US and UK put sanctions on alleged Cambodia cyber-scammers and seize $15bn in bitcoin
summary: People trafficking among allegations against six people who face measures including property freezes and travel bans The US and UK have seized $15bn (£11.3bn) in bitcoin and frozen London properties owned by the alleged leaders of scam centres in Cambodia that trick victims around the world and torture their trafficked workers. Two Chinese-born businessmen are among the six people hit by travel bans and sanctions that aim to tackle the growing threat of organised crime gangs carrying out online fraud globally on an industrial scale. title: JP Morgan boss says more ‘cockroaches’ will emerge after private credit sector failures
summary: Jamie Dimon expects further weak links in ‘shadow banking’ sector to be revealed after collapse of two US firms The boss of JP Morgan, Jamie Dimon, has warned over further losses linked to the private credit sector, saying more “cockroaches” could emerge after the collapse of the sub-prime auto lender Tricolor and the car parts supplier First Brands . The bank said on Tuesday that although it had no exposure to First Brands, which sells car parts across the US, it had taken a $170m (£128m) hit from Tricolor, which collapsed amid fraud allegations last month.
